title: azdw Defaults Configuration
description: Configuration file for azdw default settings that can be overridden per client or user.

$schema.description: Reference to the JSON schema for validation.

version.description: Configuration schema version (e.g., '1.0'). Used for migration between schema versions.

topWorkItemType.description: Default top-level work item type for hierarchy traversal (e.g., 'Epic'). Used by commands like 'relationship find-closure'. If not specified, defaults to 'Epic'.

themeLightnessOffset.description: Lightness offset used when deriving darker/lighter primary color variants from the loaded CSS theme. Smaller values produce more subtle variants; larger values produce higher contrast. Default: 0.10.

mcpOAuthClientId.description: MCP OAuth client ID for the Authorization Code + PKCE flow. Overrides the built-in azdw multi-tenant Entra ID app registration (1b5c5fc3-256f-4d5f-868b-a43b98df2168). Use this to substitute a client-specific Entra ID app registration for all URL-only MCP server entries.

followUpSuggestions.description: Controls follow-up suggestion generation in AI chat. 'enabled' (default): 3-5 suggestions after each response. 'minimal': 1-2 suggestions. 'disabled': no suggestions (saves ~150 tokens in system prompt).

connectionStalenessThresholdMinutes.description: When an AI-enabled command starts, connections whose last successful test is older than this many minutes are automatically re-tested before the first AI interaction. Set to 0 to always re-test all connections. Set to -1 (or any negative value) to disable automatic staleness checks. Default: 60.

capacityDemandField.description: Default work-item numeric field reference summed as demand by 'azdw capacity analyze' (e.g. 'Microsoft.VSTS.Scheduling.Effort'). When set, the --demand-field option becomes optional and falls back to this value; when not set, --demand-field is mandatory. No built-in default (org/process-specific).

piiApprovalValidityMinutes.description: How long (in minutes) a PII inclusion approval granted via the 'request_pii_inclusion' MCP handshake remains valid before the model must request it again. Applies to externally reachable MCP hosts where the PII inclusion gate is enabled. Non-positive values fall back to the built-in default. Default: 5.
